description.narrative: Corandes S.A. is Argentina’s leading manufacturer and marketer of tinplate containers for fruit, vegetables, meat and meat products, seafood, and aerosols, as well as metal caps. It also manufactures plastic caps.Industria Nacional de Envases S.A., INESA, is the parent company of INESA group, which, in addition to Corandes, includes INESA Chile, INESA Perú, and INESA Brasil, among others. INESA Chile manufactures a wide variety of tinplate and aluminum containers and caps for the Chilean market. It is Chile’s largest producer of such containers; it serves the fishing, food, paint, chemical, wine and beverage, and aquaculture industries.The purpose of the long-term IIC loan is to finance Corandes’s permanent operating fund requirements. The loan will strengthen Corandes’s financial structure and enable it to continue expanding and providing the market with high-quality containers.
